listing.name: Fleet Tester
listing.summary: This is a simple utility tool that offers a mission editable on run-time to setup and test various battle scenarios very quickly and test fleet-wide balance or new tactics. It can also help a lot with debugging.
listing.aiSummary: Provides a runtime-editable mission to quickly set up and test battle scenarios and fleet balance.

description:
This is a simple utility tool that offers a mission editable on run-time to setup and test various battle scenarios very quickly and test fleet-wide balance or new tactics. It can also help a lot with debugging.

Inside the mission folder you will find two fleet files that will define which ship variants are added to each opposing sides.

Those files can be edited without restarting the game, greatly speeding up the testing process.
They can also be used to setup playable challenges, or situation showcasing balance and AI issues.

Happy testing!

aiDescription: Offers a mission that can be edited while the game is running to test various battle scenarios. It allows users to define ship variants for opposing sides via editable fleet files without restarting the game. This speeds up testing for balance, tactics, and debugging.
